overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus S-Line 3-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious, rejuvenating retreat right in your home. Designed for ultimate relaxation and wellness, this sauna features 8 strategically placed Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, promoting muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood and equipped with a chromotherapy lighting system, it transforms any indoor space—be it a basement, master bath, or fitness room—into a personal spa. Enjoy the added luxury of Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity with built-in speakers, making every session a truly immersive experience.
